channel.title: Canada Flight Schedules - Canadian Aviation News & Flight Operations
channel.description: Daily updated Canadian civil aviation schedules, operational safety briefings, aerodrome procedures, and airline fleet telemetry.

item.title: The Anatomy of Winter Flight Operations in Canada: De-Icing Holdover Times, Runway Friction, and Transport Canada Directives
item.description: An exhaustive operational analysis of cold-weather airline dispatch across Canadian aerodromes, detailing Type I and Type IV glycol chemistry, Canadian Runway Friction Index (CRFI) deceleration metrics, and NAV CANADA slot management.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Capt. Robert McAllister, FRAeS)

item.title: NAV CANADA and the Space-Based ADS-B Revolution: How Satellite Surveillance Redefined Oceanic & Northern Flight Routes
item.description: A deep technical evaluation of Aireon's space-based ADS-B satellite constellation, examining how 66 Iridium NEXT low-earth-orbit satellites eliminated polar radar blind spots and reduced oceanic separation standards from 80 nautical miles down to 14.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Dr. Danielle Bouchard, P.Eng.)

item.title: Navigating Major Canadian Transit Hubs: An Operational & Layover Guide to Toronto Pearson (YYZ), Montréal-Trudeau (YUL), and Vancouver International (YVR)
item.description: A master logistical roadmap for international and domestic airline passengers connecting through Canada's top three airport hubs, featuring minimum connection times (MCT), US preclearance customs protocols, baggage transfer procedures, and terminal transits.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Marc-Andre Tremblay)

item.title: The Arctic Lifeline: How Gravel Kits, Combi Jets, and Sub-Zero Avionics Sustain Canada’s Remote Northern Territories
item.description: A deep operational investigation into aviation operations across Nunavut, the Yukon, and Northwest Territories, detailing gravel runway operations, Boeing 737 gravel deflector kits, and ETOPS extreme cold dispatch logistics.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (David K. O'Connor)

item.title: Inside the Cockpit Over the Canadian Rockies: Mountain Wave Turbulence, Required Navigation Performance, and Diversion Protocols
item.description: A technical interview and deep flight deck analysis with an active Canadian airline captain examining the aerodynamics of mountain wave turbulence over the Rocky Mountains, RNP-AR curved approaches into mountain valleys, and emergency decompression escape routes.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Capt. Julian Hayes)

item.title: The Great Canadian Transcontinental Airline War: How Porter’s Embraer E195-E2 Influx is Reshaping Air Canada and WestJet Duopoly
item.description: An in-depth market and fleet analysis of the commercial battle for Canada's transcontinental trunk routes, evaluating Porter Airlines' 50+ Embraer E195-E2 jet expansion against Air Canada's network dominance and WestJet's western consolidation.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Scott Henderson)

item.title: The Complete Guide to Canadian Air Passenger Protection Regulations (APAPR): Delay Compensation, Airline Obligations, and Transport Canada Enforcement
item.description: A definitive, authoritative legal guide to passenger rights under Canada's APAPR framework, breaking down statutory delay compensation tiers up to $1,000 CAD, controllable vs safety exceptions, baggage claims, and CTA filing steps.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Sarah Jenkins, LL.B.)

item.title: The Pride of Mirabel: How the Canadian-Designed Airbus A220-300 Revolutionized Single-Aisle Airline Economics and Range
item.description: A comprehensive aerospace engineering deep dive into the Airbus A220 (formerly Bombardier CSeries), examining its geared turbofan bypass ratios, composite carbon-fibre wing construction in Mirabel, and transcontinental economics.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Dr. Ethan Vance, Ph.D., P.Eng.)

item.title: Guardians of the North Atlantic: How Gander Oceanic Control Coordinates Thousands of Transatlantic Flights Daily Across the NAT Tracks
item.description: An exhaustive historical and technical investigation into Gander Oceanic Control (CZQX), detailing the Organized Track System (OTS), ETOPS 180-minute diversions to Goose Bay and Keflavik, and Mach number separation techniques.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Alistair MacIntyre)

item.title: High-Altitude Meteorology: Decoding Mountain Waves, Rotor Clouds, and Severe Clear-Air Turbulence Across Western Canada
item.description: A definitive atmospheric physics analysis of clear-air turbulence (CAT) and mountain wave dynamics across western Canadian mountain corridors, detailing Kelvin-Helmholtz shear instability, Froude numbers, and NAV CANADA SIGMET warnings.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Dr. Elena Rostova, Ph.D.)

item.title: Inside Airport Slot Allocation: How IATA Level 3 Capacity Constraints Shape Commercial Airline Schedules at YYZ, YVR, and YUL
item.description: A technical economic and airside logistics analysis of commercial airport slot coordination in Canada, evaluating IATA Worldwide Slot Guidelines, the 80/20 Use-It-or-Lose-It rule, wake turbulence separations, and capacity caps.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Marcus Vance)
